item.title: ArcticRAT Enlists Grok to Analyze Stolen Financial Data
item.description: Verticals Targeted: Cryptocurrency, Financial Executive Summary An evolving Android remote access trojan (RAT), ArcticRAT, has expanded from targeting cryptocurrency applications into a broader surveillance and financial information theft platform. The malware combines Android Accessibility Services abuse, hidden virtual network computing (HVNC), credential harvesting, and wireless Android Debug Bridge (ADB) functionality to enable extensive remote control of compromised devices.
